title: acb client data
description: Facts about one agent client that no open specification defines. One file per client under clients/. Every client is optional.

instruction_file_names.description: File names this client loads as agent instructions, in addition to AGENTS.md.

mcp_declaration_paths.description: Paths relative to the scanned root where this client reads MCP server declarations.

mcp_key_paths.description: Dotted key paths, inside a JSON or YAML file, where this client keeps its MCP server mapping (e.g. mcp.servers).

permission_bypass_flags.description: Command-line flags or settings this client documents as disabling permission prompts or sandboxing.

config_write_paths.description: Agent configuration locations for this client, as written in scripts (e.g. ~/.example/settings.json).

agent_settings.description: Agent settings files this client reads, and where its permission rules and hooks live inside them.

match.description: Relative path suffix, matched on whole path segments at any depth (e.g. config/settings.json).

scope.description: project: committed with the repository. managed: deployed by an organization and not overridable by users.

blocking_hook_events.description: Hook events whose handler can stop the action it runs before.

hook_path_variables.description: Variables a hook command can use for a path, and what they expand to.

self_protection_rules.description: Deny-rule groups that stop the agent's own tools from writing its configuration, extensions and instruction files.

extension_install_rules.description: Deny-rule groups that stop the agent's own tools from installing or enabling extensions.

tool_server_allow_patterns.description: Allow rule forms that approve more than one named tool of a tool server, as regular expressions matched against each allow rule.

managed_requirements.description: Values a managed-scope settings file must hold.

extension_restriction.description: Only organization-managed extensions run in-process code, and they cannot weaken deny rules.

sideload_restriction.description: Extensions cannot be loaded outside the managed install path, including ones the agent writes.

extension_packages.description: How this client's extension packages are laid out.

manifest_paths.description: Paths, relative to a package root, whose presence makes a directory an extension package.

content_paths.description: Package-relative files or directories that hold agent content (skills, commands, agents).

component_paths.description: Package-relative files or directories that declare executable components.

hook_files.description: Package-relative hook configuration files that can list in-process modules.

module_dirs.description: Package-relative directories where any file with a module suffix is in-process code.

module_event_pattern.description: Regular expression whose first group is an event name a module registers a handler for.

module_call_pattern.description: Regular expression whose first group is a host API call a module makes.

guard_events.description: Module events whose handler can refuse a tool call.

approval_events.description: Module events whose handler can approve a tool call.

high_risk_capabilities.description: Events and calls a reviewer must see justified: tool-call approval, prompt rewriting, process spawning, network requests, model calls.

command.description: Argument vector; the package directory is appended.

line_pattern.description: Regular expression with groups module, kind (events or calls) and items over the validator's output lines.

audit_notes.description: How this client implements a control's audit procedure, rendered on the control's documentation page.

source.description: Primary documentation URL that states the fact.

key_path.description: Key path inside a parsed JSON or YAML document, one segment per item.

target.description: What the rule group protects, in words.

any_of.description: Rules of which at least one must appear in the settings file's deny list.

check.description: equals: the key holds value. not-equals: the key is absent or holds something else. contains-if-present: when the key is set, its list contains value.
